solar.capacity_basis: Total projected installed small-solar nameplate capacity at each year end

ev_fleet.current_anchor_source_name: Ministry of Transport weekly electric vehicle report
ev_fleet.current_anchor_definition: Light vehicles in the report's Zero (0 g/km) fleet band; used as the conservative V2G-relevant current EV stock proxy.

path_method.mot_path_method: Uses the EECA/CCC logistic curve's normalized progress from the current anchor to 2035, scaled between the same current EV stock and the MoT 30% of 4.5 million 2035 target. This preserves S-curve timing and avoids straight-line front-loading.

methodology_notes: This is a power-capacity comparison, not an energy comparison.

EV export capacity is potentially dispatchable around peak periods but depends on vehicles being plugged in, bidirectional hardware and standards, available state of charge, network permissions and customer participation.
Solar capacity is nameplate capacity and is primarily a daytime resource; equal MW does not imply equal system value or equal annual energy.
The EECA/CCC path is a three-anchor logistic fit. The MoT path uses the same normalized adoption timing and a lower 2035 target to avoid front-loaded straight-line interpolation.
Fleet policy anchors are scenarios, not precise forecasts.
